annotations.title: utilpeek: WCAG contrast check between a foreground and a background color

description: utilpeek: Check the WCAG contrast between a text color and a background color. To convert colour formats too use convert_color_check_contrast. Returns the WCAG 2.x contrast ratio of a `foreground` and a `background` CSS color, with AA / AAA pass or fail for normal text, large text and UI components (unrounded: #777 on white is 4.48:1 and fails AA). An unparseable or out-of-range color is a 422 before any payment (not charged). A translucent color is composited over the background before the contrast is computed. Typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/color-contrast-checker-api.html

background.description: The background color it sits on, in the same CSS color formats.
background.title: Background

foreground.description: The text or UI color, a CSS color: hex (#rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa), rgb() / rgba(), hsl() / hsla() or a CSS color name.
foreground.title: Foreground
